description: WinFsp - Windows File System Proxy, user-mode file system framework (enables rclone mount)
notes: WinFsp installs a kernel driver + system service via MSI, so UAC elevation is required and the driver lives in Program Files, not the scoop dir. Official buckets do not carry it for this reason; this manifest only manages download/install/uninstall.
post_install: if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/i $($msi.FullName) /qn" -Verb RunAs -Wait } else { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/i $($msi.FullName) /qn" -Wait }
if (Get-Service WinFsp.Launcher -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'WinFsp service installed.' } else { error 'WinFsp service not found after install - did you accept the UAC prompt?' }
pre_uninstall: if ($msi) { if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/x $($msi.FullName) /qn" -Verb RunAs -Wait } else { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/x $($msi.FullName) /qn" -Wait } }
